about.title:
Design engineer
in training.
about.body:
I'm a Mechanical Engineering student at Al Hussein Technical University (HTU), focused on the intersection of mechanical design and mechatronic systems — where CAD geometry, structural analysis, and manufacturing constraints have to resolve into something that actually works.

One of my recent team projects, Velvet Vend, pushed me through a full development cycle: SolidWorks modeling, DFM-driven tolerancing for laser-cut and FDM parts, supporting electrical integration, and diagnosing a real hardware failure under time pressure — a control board damaged by a power-supply transient, resolved by migrating the architecture rather than swapping parts.

My project range also covers structural FEA validated against analytical models — cross-checking a simulated elastic modulus against the closed-form relation E = 2G(1+ν) — CFD-informed load cases for aerospace structures, and experimental energy-system testing, where I measured a 25.6% conversion efficiency on a self-built Pelton turbine generator against calculated hydraulic power input.

I'm focused on mechanical design, product development, and advanced manufacturing — building toward a design engineering career grounded in the same design–analyze–build–validate loop across every project I take on.
